episodes.title: First Time
episodes.summary: A schoolyard fight leads to a chance encounter between Miyano and Sasaki.  As their friendship blossoms and Miyano introduces Sasaki to Boy's Love manga, Sasaki wrestles with newfound and unfamiliar feelings.

episodes.title: Someone I Like
episodes.summary: The school year slowly marches forward. As Sasaki and Miyano‘s relationship depends, the other guys at school take notice. Sasaki struggles with the intensity of his feelings.

episodes.title: Senpai Is...
episodes.summary: As Miyano continues lending Sasaki BL manga, he worries he might be bringing Sasaki negative attention. Miano begins to question the nature of Sasaki‘s relationship with him.

episodes.title: Limit
episodes.summary: Sasaki becomes less and less able to hide his feelings. Ogasawara gets fujoshi help from a fudanshi. Miyano continues to question his relationship with Sasaki.

episodes.title: Bit by Bit
episodes.summary: Sasaki finally decides to tell Miyano how he feels. However, Sasaki's nerves get to him and make him say the wrong thing. Can he find a way to fix his mistake?

episodes.title: Feelings
episodes.summary: Despite pouring over the issue, Miyano struggles to define how he feels about Sasaki. In a rare moment alone with Sasaki, Miyano worked up the courage to address his feelings.

episodes.title: I Don't Want to Pressure Him
episodes.summary: Miyano finds out the cultural festival will have a cross dressing competition. As Sasaki does his best to wait patiently for Miyano's answer about his feelings, a familiar face from Miyano's past brings Miyano a new perspective.

episodes.title: I Realized
episodes.summary: Ogasawara gets Miyano‘s help with another lovers' quarrel. Preparations for the cultural festival begin in earnest. As the chairman helps Miyano with his look for the cross dressing competition, Miyano seeks wisdom about love.

episodes.title: I Want to Take Good Care of You, Senpai
episodes.summary: Miyano struggles to figure out what to tell Sasaki. Sasaki get sick. The day of the cultural festival finally arrives.

episodes.title: Love
episodes.summary: At the Hooligan Fortune Café, Miyano gets more wisdom from the chairman. Miyano competes in the cross dressing competition, and he and Sasaki see the festival together. Miyano makes a major breakthrough.

episodes.title: What Do I Do About These Feelings?
episodes.summary: Miyano finally knows how he feels Although he doesn't know it, Miyano repays all the wisdom and advice Ogasawara gave him. Despite his newfound confidence in his feelings, Milano struggles to find the right time to tell Sasaki. Did he wait too long?

episodes.title: Just Beginning
episodes.summary: Now that Miyano is sure of his feelings, he can finally tell Sasaki. However, a misunderstanding threatens to derail everything.
